title: ID0422483-DC/Si-D/EE-[s6lyo8]-PLC has communication error with AC meter
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  AC chargig stopping suddenly →
PLC has communication error with AC meter. This is now another case (first case ID0420063). Could this be software related issue?
Solution: Update to v8.X

additional_info.subject: ID0422483-DC/Si-D/EE-[s6lyo8]-PLC has communication error with AC meter CRM:00315002596
additional_info.body:
Dear Markus Roiha,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco

Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Warehouse unit
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
s6lyo8
Problem Description
: AC sessions stop without interaction
Troubleshooting
: I checked the logs and found that for the last 4 weeks we had 1k occurrences of “PLC has communication error with AC meter”
Since the sessions are charging properly, it doesn't seem to be a problem with PLC, my first suspicion is that the Ethernet cable might not be connected properly or similar situation.
Second suspicion is that the Meter has some kind of problem where it recovers after sometime.
My recommendation would be to first check if the Ethernet cable is indeed attached properly to both sides (Meter and Switch XF2) and if it is, trial replacing the Ethernet cable.
If it doesn't work, please replace the BC5.
Let me know your thoughts and questions before I send the ticket to your queue for the follow up.
For future reference, your case number is
0422483
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
